Our Services

What We Advise On

From establishing a business and formalising its governance to negotiating transactions, managing regulatory exposure and resolving disputes, we advise on the legal decisions that shape direction and protect value.

Business, Corporate & Commercial

We advise businesses throughout their lifecycle, from incorporation and structuring to governance, commercial contracting, employment, compliance and restructuring.

Our Services Include:

  • Business Formation
  • Corporate & Commercial Advisory
  • Corporate Structuring & Governance
  • Contract Drafting & Review
  • Legal & Regulatory Compliance
  • Commercial Documentation
  • Company Secretarial Services
  • Due Diligence
  • Employment & Workforce Advisory
  • Business Compliance
  • Regulatory Compliance & Engagement
  • Risk Management

The Lummina Approach

Structure before speed. Governance as a system. Intentional drafting.

Durable legal work starts with architecture, alignment and documents that are designed to withstand scrutiny, time and dispute.

We Start With the Objective

Before recommending a solution, we understand what the client is trying to accomplish.

We identify Material Risk

We identify the risks that could materially affect the transaction, business or client.

We Design for Execution

We consider commercial realities, operational requirements and regulatory constraints, and design actionable solutions.

We Stay Accountable to the Outcome

We communicate clearly, manage matters deliberately and remain focused on the client's underlying objective.

Build with clarity

Need a tailored solution for your unique challenge?

Whether you are building, investing, evolving or protecting what matters, Lummina provides clear, commercially intelligent guidance for what comes next.
